requirements.text: At least 3 years leading a marketing or growth team with budget ownership, including leads in your team
Funnels you have personally made convert (visitor to lead, appointment or purchase), with before-and-after numbers you can defend
Acquisition you have scaled across paid and organic, with CRO, tracking and attribution, steered on CAC and cost per outcome
Pace: tests weekly, kills what does not work and scales what does
Willingness to be in the Stuttgart HQ regularly (10-30%)
E-commerce, high-ticket DTC, or SME SaaS background
Experience with a sales-assisted motion: qualification, handover, and show rates
Experience with interactive product demos or a self-serve or product-led funnel
AI-native ways of working across content, design, and analysis

resumes.text:
JULIA BRANDT

Summary
Growth and marketing leader with eight years in e-commerce and SME SaaS. I have led teams of up to twelve people, owned seven-figure budgets, and built acquisition engines that are judged on cost per outcome. I work fast, test every week, and kill what does not work.

Experience
Head of Growth Marketing, Aurelio Commerce, Hamburg (2021 - present)
- Lead a team of nine across paid media, lifecycle and SEO, including three team leads, with a yearly budget of 2.4 million euros.
- Rebuilt the landing page flow for our online store. Booked sales calls rose from 40 to 118 per month, and the conversion rate went from 1.2 percent to 3.4 percent, measured in our analytics dashboard.
- Scaled paid and organic acquisition, CRO, tracking and attribution, steering every channel on CAC and cost per acquisition.
- Ran a weekly creative testing cycle: new ads launched every Monday, underperformers were killed within two weeks, and winners were scaled.
- Built an AI-based pipeline that drafts ad copy variants and generates the weekly performance report automatically for the leadership team.

Marketing Manager, Quellwerk SaaS, Berlin (2018 - 2021)
- Owned the inbound lead process for an SME software product. I qualified leads, handed them to sales, and tracked show rates for each rep.
- Managed a marketing budget of 600,000 euros with monthly reviews.

Education
BSc Business Administration, University of Hamburg, 2017

Skills
Paid search, LinkedIn ads, SEO, CRO, marketing analytics, team leadership. English (C2). German (A2, currently taking evening classes).

Availability
Happy to be at the Stuttgart HQ regularly, around 10 to 30 percent of the time.

NINA ROTH

Summary
Marketing lead with six years of experience in B2B software, focused on growth campaigns and conversion. I like hands-on work on landing pages and paid channels, and I am moving into a leadership role.

Experience
Growth Marketing Lead, Lumenfield Software, Hamburg (2024 - present)
- Lead a team of five growth marketers. I have led the team for two years and manage an annual budget of 300,000 euros.
- Built landing pages for our SME software product that raised the lead form conversion rate from 2 to 4 percent.
- Ran paid and organic acquisition across search and social, with tracking and attribution set up in our analytics tools, and results steered on cost per acquisition.
- Launched a free-trial sign-up flow where new users started using the product without any contact from sales.

Marketing Manager, Brisk Analytics, Berlin (2020 - 2023)
- Managed content and webinars for a B2B analytics product.
- Produced quarterly campaign reports for the executive team.

Education
BA Communication Studies, Leipzig University, 2019

Skills
Landing page design, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, webinars, copywriting. English (C1). German (A1, from school).

STEFAN KOCH

Summary
Hospitality manager with a decade of experience running restaurants and private events. I am good with people, budgets and schedules, and I am looking for a new challenge outside the restaurant business.

Experience
Restaurant Operations Manager, Gasthaus Zur Linde, Mannheim (2019 - present)
- Lead a team of eight shift supervisors and about 40 staff across two sites.
- Manage a yearly food and events budget of about 900,000 euros and report monthly to the owners.
- Run the restaurant's Instagram page, which has about 800 followers, posting weekly menu photos and event announcements.
- Organize seasonal tasting evenings for 60 guests and coordinate with local caterers.

Event Coordinator, Neckar Festival Group, Mannheim (2014 - 2019)
- Planned summer festivals and corporate dinners for up to 500 guests.
- Handled vendor contracts and on-site logistics.

Education
Vocational training as a restaurant specialist, Mannheim Hospitality School, 2014

Skills
Staff scheduling, budgeting, event planning, customer service, Instagram posting. English (C1), used daily with international guests. German (A1, learning).

Availability
Happy to be on-site at the Stuttgart office regularly, with plenty of notice.
